title: persist unresolvedAtCompletion on the task record and make it queryable across completed tasks, instead of only emitting it once in the completion response
description:
Raised by opum-agent (2026-09-18, dispatched at 12:44Z with the user's approval).

QCLI-252 (Done) established that `task complete` with unchecked acceptance criteria/definition-of-done is intended, not a bug: it prints a stderr warning and adds `unresolvedAtCompletion` to the JSON response naming the unchecked items (src/cli/main.ts:298, 2493, 2499 -- `unresolvedAtCompletion(data)` is computed in the CLI response layer only, called from the `complete` branch of the command dispatch, and spliced into that one response object). It is NOT written to the persisted task record: grep of .quest/tasks/*.json for the field finds nothing, and the domain completion path (TasksService.complete / transitionTask) never touches it.

The gap opum-agent names: the moment a task closes, that response is gone. "We knowingly shipped with X open" is real information at completion time and unreachable a minute later -- not in `task view`, not in `task list`, not in `search`, not in `doctor`. Nothing lets someone ask "which completed tasks shipped with open acceptance criteria" across the tracker.

acceptanceCriteria.text: task complete persists the unresolvedAtCompletion list (the unchecked AC/DoD items at the moment of completion) onto the task record itself, not only the one-shot JSON response
quest task view --json surfaces the persisted field for a completed task that had it

A query surface exists to find completed tasks carrying unresolvedAtCompletion -- task list --json exposing the field for filtering, or a dedicated flag -- so a sweep does not require reading every completed record by hand
Existing completed records with no persisted field are left alone (unknown, not false) rather than backfilled by inference
quest manifest --json and quest help task complete / quest help task list document the new field and any new flag

plan: 1. Move the unresolvedAtCompletion computation from the CLI response layer into the domain (domain/tasks/tasks.ts) and persist it on TaskState via tasks.complete()
2. Add the field to the taskSchema zod validator and TaskInput exclusions so it round-trips through storage and cannot be set at creation
3. Add a task list --unresolved-at-completion filter querying the persisted field
4. Update quest help/manifest (command-help.ts, command-contract.ts) and the public tracker contract fixtures/validator (src/contract/tracker/*.ts) for the new field and filter
5. Add regression tests pinning persistence, the new filter, and that the field is set once and not recomputed on later edits
6. Run bun run check end to end before opening the PR
implementationNotes: All 5 acceptance criteria verified with evidence, not on faith: AC1/AC2 pinned by qcli336 test 1 (task complete persists the field, task view --json surfaces it on a later read, not just the completion response). AC3 pinned by qcli336 test 2 (task list --unresolved-at-completion returns only the completed task with unresolved items, excludes a fully-resolved completed task and a never-completed one). AC4: no backfill/migration code was written -- the zod field is .optional() and existing records are simply read as absent; qcli336 test 3 additionally confirms the field is set once at completion and not retroactively recomputed on a later edit, which is the same 'do not infer from current state' principle applied going forward. AC5 pinned by qcli336 test 4 (manifest --json) plus test/contract/command-contract.test.ts's golden and the QCLI-139 filter-list test, both updated. Found during implementation: the field/filter list this task touches is declared in FOUR places, not one -- application/command-contract.ts (manifest), src/contract/tracker/fixtures.ts and index.ts (the public tracker adapter contract + its own probe() exact-match validator), and two test goldens -- all four now updated and re-verified by bun run check (572 pass, typecheck/lint/format/layers clean).

finalSummary: Persisted QCLI-252's response-only unresolvedAtCompletion signal onto the task record: complete() (application/tasks/tasks.ts) now computes it via a new domain function (domain/tasks/tasks.ts's unresolvedAtCompletion(), reusing normalizeCheckList's unchecked-item logic) and writes it into TaskState, which the zod taskSchema now validates and TaskInput excludes from creation. task view/task list --json surface it on any later read of a completed task, and task list --unresolved-at-completion filters to exactly the completed tasks still carrying one. Documented in quest help (task view/task list/task complete) and quest manifest (command-contract.ts), and propagated to the public tracker adapter contract, which turned out to declare the same field/filter list in two more places (src/contract/tracker/fixtures.ts and index.ts's own probe() exact-match validator) -- all four now agree. Deliberately not retroactive: set once at completion, never recomputed by a later edit to the completed task's checklist. Verified with a new test file (test/qcli336-unresolved-at-completion.test.ts, 4 tests) plus updates to the existing QCLI-137 (manifest field-presence) and QCLI-139 (filter-list) goldens. bun run check: 572 tests pass, typecheck/lint/format/layer-check all clean.
